HRA Analysis: CAMERINA (10) was an impressive winner last time out when working to the lead and taking them all the way rating fast time over the 1660 holding off Bettor Be Bohdi. She draws the back row this time but finds another suitable race and should still be hard to beat. ALLMIGHTY MAX (1) was able to control things out in front last time out at Redcliffe and proved too good there. He should be able to drive through and lead in this race and is usually hard to run down out in front. PUNTERS JEWEL (3) has been racing in stronger company and appears to find a more suitable race here. He did some work early last time out and faded late over the 2138. He could be more suited back to the 1660 and with a more economical run early in this race. LOSTANDFOUND (8) should get a good run through early in this race behind the likely leader in the race ALLMIGHTY MAX (1). He ran a good third two starts ago behind Ratatattat over the 2040 at Redcliffe after leading. SELECTIONS: CAMERINA (10), ALLMIGHTY MAX (1), PUNTERS JEWEL (3), LOSTANDFOUND (8) SUGGESTED BET: CAMERINA (10) to win.

A PERFECT DANCE (2) has very good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race. She was forced to sit without cover last time out and battled on well for fourth behind Rock Nien. BELLISSIMO ACQUISTO (9) has impressed since joining the stable of Matt Elkins and returns in this race from a spell. He looks to land a favourable draw where he can settle close to the speed following a gate speed horse at the start. PROTAGONIST (4) looks a big query runner in this race having not started in a race since February. He trialled up well enough recently behind FFA runners Dashing and Hector when finishing third. BONNIES CAM (1) looks likely to be able to lead in this race before having options from there. He may be best suited in this race driven with a sit given the likely strong pressure which should see him get a similar run to the one he had when running a very good second to Sweet Rocky recently. SELECTIONS: A PERFECT DANCE (2), BELLISSIMO ACQUISTO (9), PROTAGONIST (4), BONNIES CAM (1) SUGGESTED BET: A PERFECT DANCE (2) to win.

LONGSHOT (7) got back to last in his latest outing and couldn’t get into the race there. He draws the front row this time and can look to bounce back in this race. SHE MAYBE BETTOR (2) looks like she may be able to press forward and find the lead in this race. She ran well two starts ago when flashing into second late behind Warrawe Flyer. SMIRKS LIKA BOSS (1) should be able to drive through and lead before having options from there having previously been noted this horse is best when driven with a sit over the 2138. He has been left to race off the pegs in recent outings and could be an improver in this race on the rails. LAST HAND (6) trialled up reasonably recently behind Charmed Conquest at this track. He led and was run down late by LONGSHOT (7) in his latest race start. SELECTIONS: LONGSHOT (7), SHE MAYBE BETTOR (2), SMIRKS LIKA BOSS (1), LAST HAND (6) SUGGESTED BET: LONGSHOT (7) to win.

ROCKIN SWEET (9) secured the ideal run behind the leader last time out but did appear to get a touch keen which may have dulled his late sprint finishing third in a race taken out by Major Ark. He looks suited in this race and should run well again. MAYWYNS KAREN (4) has good gate speed and should find a prominent position in the early stages of this race. She was running on late last time out into third behind Jay Tee Tyron and Pocket Book. MY SCIMITAR (8) sat without cover last time out and battled on well for second there behind Major Ark. He should get a good run behind the speed and can be running on late. TIGER TOMMY (7) ran well last time out when securing a good run behind Harry Kane and running on nicely into second there. This race looks no tougher but she will need the race run to suit given she looks likely to get back from the wide draw. SELECTIONS: ROCKIN SWEET (9), MAYWYNS KAREN (4), MY SCIMITAR (8), TIGER TOMMY (7) SUGGESTED BET: ROCKIN SWEET (9) to win.

VICTREE CHARLIE (10) looks very well graded in this race having taken on stronger company and run well. He ran well two starts ago when not beaten far in third by Milliewood. He should be running on again. BEAU STEELE (2) was able to secure the perfect run 1 out 1 back last time out and was able to run over the top late to score. He should be able to find the front this time and can be hard to run down from there. POCKET BOOK (5) led last time out which isn’t a position she is usually best suited to and she was able to run well for second there behind Jay Tee Tyron. She may be shuffled back early and should be running on well late. KINGSBURY (6) draws poorly in this race and may be shuffled back in the early stages. He ran well recently running on strongly into second behind Harry Kane. SELECTIONS: VICTREE CHARLIE (10), BEAU STEELE (2), POCKET BOOK (5), KINGSBURY (6) SUGGESTED BET: VICTREE CHARLIE (10) to win.

SECOND TO NUN (9) found the front three starts ago and was able to take them all the way there beating Serena Love. She hasn’t had quite as much luck in recent outings and can look to bounce back in this race. LAYDOWNLUNA (10) was a good winner at Marburg when finding the front and taking them all the way there. She then secured a good run last time out and battled on to finish midfield behind Love Gun. GETOVERROVER (8) ran very well last time out to finish third to Whirlwind Wilbur at Marburg. He draws awkwardly inside the back row and will need a few things to go his way in the run. NATTY PAGGER (4) was able to find the front last time out from the stand start and was just run down late by the horse on his back. He has gate speed and if he was able to find the front he would likely run well again. SELECTIONS: SECOND TO NUN (9), LAYDOWNLUNA (10), GETOVERROVER (8), NATTY PAGGER (4) SUGGESTED BET: SECOND TO NUN (9) to win.

RESERVED FOR ME (2) secured a good run behind the speed on debut and was running on late into third behind stablemate Big Reputation. She looks likely to get a good run close to the speed in this race and should be hard to beat. UNCLE NOLAN (3) didn’t have the best of luck last time out when settling 1-1 and was running on strongly to just come up short behind Broadwaybeauty. He should be able to work forward and find a prominent position in this race and should be very hard to beat. BLING YOUR A GAME (4) showed good gate speed in a recent trial to lead and was run down late by Rocky Leigh. He should settle in a prominent position and has likely derived benefit from his recent trial. MISS MONEY PENNY (5) got back in the run last time out as a result of an early break. She ran through the line nicely late and is likely to have derived a lot of benefit from the first up outing. SELECTIONS: RESERVED FOR ME (2), UNCLE NOLAN (3), BLING YOUR A GAME (4), MISS MONEY PENNY (5) SUGGESTED BET: RESERVED FOR ME (2) to win.

INSTANT DELIGHT (1) appears to be quite well handicapped in this race starting off the front. She secured a good run off the speed and was running on late into second last time out behind Love Gun. DAIMYO (3) looks well handicapped in this race and should be able to find a prominent position. He did things wrong last time out and was well beaten as a result there. WHIRLWIND WILBUR (6) ran well for third behind Love Gun last time out at this track. He faces a 20m handicap this time which does appear likely to make things tougher. HAMMER SON (2) looks well handicapped in this race and should secure the right type of run. He is building towards full fitness and put in a solid run last time out finishing sixth behind Love Gun. SELECTIONS: INSTANT DELIGHT (1), DAIMYO (3), WHIRLWIND WILBUR (6), HAMMER SON (2) SUGGESTED BET: INSTANT DELIGHT (1) to win. OVERVIEW:COLLEAGUES (7) has gait issues but he appears to be hard to beat against this class if he delivers a fool proof display. He was going to finish in second at Maryborough last week but broke stride at the 100m mark and ended up being placed in fifth. OLIVER SMUDGE (5) hasn’t raced since May 2023 but he was a runaway trial winner at Maryborough last week. He is nicely bred and strikes a suitable assignment for his first up performance so he cannot be underestimated. SOME DAYS WE DREAM (1) is resuming since December and hasn’t been to the trials but she is worth thought from the pole position. LITTLER (2) is ideally drawn and is capable of filling a place. SELECTIONS: COLLEAGUES (7), OLIVER SMUDGE (5), SOME DAYS WE DREAM (1), LITTLER (2)

OVERVIEW:PIRANI PERFECT (4) has been placed in both of her starts since transferring to trainer Rebecca Bartley and met a stronger field when second behind Crackin Philtra in a slick mile rate of 1.56.0 at Kilmore last outing. She possesses early speed and gets her chance to break through for a win. MAJOR LINCOLN (7) was slow away and settled a clear last early when fifth at Swan Hill last outing. He was placed at his five attempts prior and should be hitting the line strongly. ROJENBYE (3) performs well at Charlton having been placed in four of his six starts (2 wins) to date. He is better drawn than his recent performances and gets his chance to improve on his numerical form. PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (6) disappointed at Hamilton last week but he is a fast beginner and this race is easier so he can show improvement. BACK: PIRANI PERFECT (4) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: PIRANI PERFECT (4), MAJOR LINCOLN (7), ROJENBYE (3), PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (6)

OVERVIEW: LOU EASYANA (8) should be getting fitter after having two starts back from a spell and finished very nicely when second behind Huxham Chubb at Hamilton last week. This race appears to be easier so she is a good chance of going one better now. TOTALLY STUNNING (7) has returned from a spell in good form having been placed in all of her four attempts and looms as one of the leading chances again. She finished quickly to win at Shepparton on September 15 and finished off well for third in a slick mile rate of 1.53.9 at Wagga last outing. HUNGRY HOGARTH (3) settled midfield, raced fiercely and finished off solidly for a close second at Swan Hill last outing. This race is no harder and he should be competitive again. LEONARD (6) sustained a flat tyre when in the leading role and had excuses last outing. He led throughout at a recent Swan Hill victory and is worth another chance. BACK: LOU EASYANA (8) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: LOU EASYANA (8), TOTALLY STUNNING (7), HUNGRY HOGARTH (3), LEONARD (6)

OVERVIEW: ICANMOTOR (7) has had several chances since his latest victory but he was placed three times in succession against similar grade back in October and should run a good race again despite the wide draw. DANCIN WITH ELVIS (2) is a fast beginner and gets his chance to improve on his recent efforts. He met a stronger field at Hamilton on October 26 and is backing up quickly from his effort at Mount Gambier on Friday night. GO GEORGE GO (4) is a grinding type that finished third from behind the leader at his latest appearance. He has had four starts on the track for a win and a third and is worth thought under these conditions. MY LUCKY ROCK (1) has been safely held at her two starts back from a break but she should be getting fitter and her form last preparation would suggest she can be competitive against this line up. SELECTIONS: ICANMOTOR (7), DANCIN WITH ELVIS (2), GO GEORGE GO (4), MY LUCKY ROCK (1)

OVERVIEW:SPORTS WRACK (4) hasn’t won a race in 19 starts for the season but this is his easiest assignment for a long time and he has the early speed to give a forward showing. He settled midfield on the markers when sixth behind Krissy at Kilmore last outing. JAMES GARNER (8) is resuming since a fourth at Ararat in March and hasn’t been to the trials but he would go close if he is somewhere near his peak. NO EMOTION (2) will appreciate a slight drop back in class and wasn’t beaten by far at his latest Charlton appearance behind Eyesealittle and Huxham Chubb (won twice since). He is drawn to run a good race. OUTBACK QUEENIE (9) has performed below her best since resuming but she appears to be better placed against this field and gets her chance to improve. SELECTIONS: SPORTS WRACK (4), JAMES GARNER (8), NO EMOTION (2), OUTBACK QUEENIE (9)

OVERVIEW: It is an open race with many winning chances. HALF AS TOUGH (11) settled midfield and came out three horses wide from the 600m when a creditable second behind the smart 2yo pacer Dispersion at Hamilton last week. He is poorly drawn but should be competitive again. IDEAL HIGH (7) followed HALF AS TOUGH (11) all of the way and held his own over the latter stages when third in the same race last week. He should continue to benefit from race experience and is worth an investment. ITS HYDROMATIC (6) has only been placed once in 21 starts but he was performing nicely at the trials prior to a fast finishing sixth when resuming at Kilmore so he gets his chance to improve. The former New South Wales pacer KELLYS COMMOTION (10) ran a reasonable race when third behind Millies Boy at her Victorian debut and is not without a chance. BACK: HALF AS TOUGH (11) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: HALF AS TOUGH (11), IDEAL HIGH (7), ITS HYDROMATIC (6), KELLYS COMMOTION (10)

OVERVIEW: MISSMALACHITE (4) continues to perform consistently having been placed in six of her past eight starts and missed out by a narrow margin at Ballarat last outing. She possesses early speed and should make her presence felt. LESTER (9) is resuming since May and hasn’t been to the trials but he should prove hard to beat if he is close to his peak. He has won a race at Charlton previously and gets into this race nicely with a concession claim. YANKEE GAMBLER (10) should be building on his fitness after having two starts back from a spell. He performs best when he is close to the speed so being drawn on the second line is a disadvantage but he does have the ability to test this field. SKADI (2) led throughout at a Swan Hill victory on September 08 and has claims along with ESPERANZA (1) and ZEUSS (5), which will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment. SELECTIONS: MISSMALACHITE (4), LESTER (9), YANKEE GAMBLER (10), ZEUSS (5)

OVERVIEW: SAINT EYES (3) settled midfield and was held up for a run at a vital stage before finishing stoutly for second behind Snickers Express at Maryborough last outing. His two efforts since resuming have been sound and he is worth thought again. CONNIES PRESIDENT (8) has won two of his past four starts and looms as one of the leading chances again. He trailed the leader after commencing from the inside of the second line when he won at Horsham two starts ago then picked up ground from the second half of the field at Maryborough. WHY NOW (11) commenced from the tough handicap of 40m when third behind the in-form mare Keayang Minnesota at his latest performance so he is worth thought from the same mark against this slightly easier grade. ATABOY CHARLIE (4) has performed below his best form in two starts back from a break but he is a fast beginner and should be getting fitter so he is worth thought. SELECTIONS: SAINT EYES (3), CONNIES PRESIDENT (8), WHY NOW (11), ATABOY CHARLIE (4)

OVERVIEW: CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (1) is a former New Zealander, which was performing well at the trials prior to a third in the West Wyalong Cup on his Australian debut, where he commenced from the second line and was driven aggressively to find the lead with two laps remaining. He appears to be ideally placed from the pole position and will take beating. MY MATE ACE (3) is stepping up in class but is racing at his peak form and is a chance of completing four straight victories. He trailed the leader and used the sprint lane when he defeated Tryx Vixen (won since) at Kilmore last outing. THE WISE GUY (2) was resuming since August 2025 when he worked home reasonably well for third behind Decode in a sizzling mile rate of 1.54.9. He should have benefited from that performance and is better drawn so he must be considered as a winning chance. RABADA (5) is resuming but was racing at Metropolitan level at his last campaign and has claims along with EMILY VINCENT (7) and MISTER JIMARINGLE (10), which bounced back to his best form with a win in a career best mile rate of 1.54.5 at Kilmore last outing. BACK: CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (1), MY MATE ACE (3), THE WISE GUY (2), RABADA (5)

OVERVIEW: SURETHING (7) was resuming since a victory at Mildura in June when she attempted to lead early, was stranded without cover and eased back to the markers to settle three back at her latest creditable second. She should be fitter from that performance and is capable of overcoming the poor draw. ROCKAMARA (8) has only been successful once in 13 attempts but that victory was at Melton over Sheer Me (won twice since) and the mile rate was a quick 1.55.7. Her recent efforts have been in South Australia and she must be considered as a winning chance on her Victorian return. BUBBLE OVER (9) was resuming since May when third behind the smart pacer Colosimo at Terang. She should be fitter from that run and is worth following. PHILS BOY (5) beaten the easier Maiden class at Mildura last outing but he won easily and has improved with every start to date. He is worth thought along with JANSEN (10), which was a winner at Maryborough on October 12. SELECTIONS: SURETHING (7), ROCKAMARA (8), BUBBLE OVER (9), PHILS BOY (5)

LUSTROUS (6) broke into a gallop twice during the run last start but made up some ground. If he can trot smoothly today and do everything right with Ryan Hryhorec in the sulky he is going to be hard to beat. CASH ME UP (4) looks like the main danger after an excellent start to her racing career with a win and a second from her first two career starts. NORTHBOUNDBUSINESS (2) and BORN ELITE (3) are both chances if they can trot smoothly.

IDEOLOGY (2) will most likely be the shortest priced favourite of the day. He had some tough runs in Melbourne recently but he returns to SA today where he was winning most of his races during the winter. He looks very hard to beat today. JILLIBY BLISS (1) will be very dangerous from the inside draw after an impressive win last start. EMILY MEAGAN (3) and LOW LIE THE FIELDS (6) are also chances.

STORMY MADEM (10) was a bit restless last start but she was a winner two starts back when she defeated LARDY DAH LADY by 9.4 metres. A repeat of that run will make her hard to beat today. BERSAGLIERE (9) looks like a big danger but he can be very hot and cold with his form at times. FIRESIDE (5) and BROBENAH GIRL (6) are also chances.
LAMBRO BAY (7) has shown some ability at the trials. His stable and driver must be respected in such an even and tricky race. CLARENDEN NITRO (8), JUST VIENNA (1) and PARVATI (2) are also chances.

BELLA ROMA (1) will love the inside draw today. She is a different filly when she can find the lead. If she leads today she will be very hard to catch. CAPTAINS DREAM (4), JILLIBY CHAMBERS (9) and WHITESTARCHRISTIAN (3) are also chances.

FEARFULL DRAGON (4) ran second behind JAWSOFGOODTIME and he was beaten by 3.2 metres. He has been knocking on the door for another win and he finds his sort of race today. SWEETKINDOFMAGIC (5) has won two of his last five starts. If he gets the right run then he will be a major threat. NORMY (2) and PERFECT PLAYGIRL (9) are also chances.

A MAJOR STARR (8) will need some luck from the inside of the second row but he was an impressive last start winner here at Globe Derby. He doesn’t mind the longer 2230 metre journey. If he can receive some luck he will be hard to beat. ASHANTE PRINCE (4), NIGHT SPIRIT (9) and UPRIGHT (1) are also chances.

JACKIE DANIELS (6) was very impressive two starts back at Globe Derby when she defeated KEAYANG SHADOWBOX by 9.7 metres. She is a big threat again today after a disappointing run last week. HEREFORAGOODTIME (1) will be a big threat from the inside draw. He should be holding the lead. GUEST ARTIST (9) and AMIRA MARIE (2) are also chances.

SWEET ARPEGGIO (4) defeated CAPTAINS DREAM by a short half head last start in what was a terrific performance. Today’s race looks easier if anything. She is worth strong consideration. WEREGOINGTOGETCHA (8), HUGH GO (5) and CLARENDEN LEGACY (7) are also chances.

IMA DESTROYER (5) is a star performer from the mobile start. She should be able to begin well and find the lead. If she can lead then she will be extremely hard to catch. STAR OF PATRICK (3), FEEL THE MOMENT (7) and NOTHING I WANT (8) are also chances.
